title: 第十一章 超青藏高原73第十一章 超青藏高原72
content_zh:
八、天神木的心脏中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟早知道原来的历史。
那段历史是这样记录的——翔天、亚树、美雅和田奈奈知道了天神木守护人说的病患所在，借用村民们的梯子爬上了巨大的天神木。
美雅通过歌声使天神木苏醒。另一方面，莫雷拿着魔王力量提炼成的魔神之剑，企图彻底杀死天神木。
翔天、亚树、美雅和田奈奈拼死阻拦，让美雅先把花粉拿去救治天神木。
莫雷狡猾地甩开他们，抢在前头用魔神之剑击碎了装着太阳花花粉的瓶子。
因为魔神剑粘上花粉，使得天神木因祸得福复活了。天神木为了感谢翔天、亚树、美雅和田奈奈四个人，将他们传送到圣兽区。
那是没有逆转时空之前的原始历史。但现在不同了。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟让中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅唱歌。
美雅站在天神木巨大的树干上，双手轻按在粗糙的树皮表面，嘴唇微启。
歌声从她的喉咙里流淌出来，不是语言，是旋律——一种古老的、猫人族世代相传的唤醒之歌。
歌声沿着天神木的树皮纹路向四面八方扩散，树干深处传来一声低沉的共鸣，像是有什么东西在漫长的沉睡之后终于动了动手指。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧听着歌声，轻声说：“说到底，本质上凝聚地球希望盼望力量所化力量而已。”八个人沿着天神木树干内部的天然通道向上攀行，来到天神木心脏所在的树洞。
那是一个巨大的空间，洞壁上密密麻麻地缠绕着发光的藤蔓，藤蔓全部汇聚到洞中央一颗悬浮的黄亮色光球上。
光球很大，大到足以容纳数人站立其中，表面流转着黄光色的能量纹路，每一次跳动都会让整棵天神木的脉络同步闪烁。
那就是天神木的心脏。但心脏的光泽不对——它本该是黄光色的，此刻却蒙着一层灰暗的阴翳，跳动频率缓慢而不稳定。
空灵族蝙蝠人从树洞顶部落下，倒挂在树壁上，驾驶着一台轻薄的黑色机甲，背部展开两对金属蝠翼，双臂末端装着两把音波刃。
莫雷站在蝙蝠人机甲后方的一块树壁平台上，手中握着魔神之剑——剑身暗紫色，由魔王的力量提炼而成，剑刃上跳动着黑色的电光。
莫雷的机甲名为莫雷空灵机，此刻正悬浮在他身后，机体修长，装甲呈暗紫色，胸口核心与魔神之剑的黑色电光同步跳动。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天抬起右腕，召唤器固定在手腕上，徽章插在召唤器中。
“烈风！”元气金刚烈风拔地而起，赤红色装甲在树洞的黄亮色光线中燃烧如一团火焰。
神光剑出现在烈风手中——红剑在左手，黑剑在右手。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天站在图案空间中，烈风双剑交叉斩向莫雷。

莫雷举起魔神之剑格挡。魔神之剑的黑色电光与神光剑的红黑光刃碰撞，能量碎片四溅。
魔神之剑开始吸收烈风的剑刃能量——暗紫色剑身上的黑色电光变得更加粗壮，吸收的能量越多，摧毁天神木的威力就越强。
但这一次不同了。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟同时启动星卡。
四道神奇的天黄色的光芒从四张星卡中射出，在莫雷与烈风之间形成一面干扰光幕。
光幕没有攻击力，它只做一件事——阻断魔神之剑的吸收回路。魔神之剑的黑色电光在接触到光幕的瞬间被反弹回剑身，吸收通道被切断。
莫雷的脸色变了。莫雷无法用魔神剑吸收烈风的力量。他咬牙转向天神木心脏，亲自驾驶莫雷空灵机举起魔神之剑，直接刺向心脏光球。
没有了吸收来的能量，魔神之剑本身的破坏力不足以一击摧毁心脏，但足以造成重创。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树与中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈同时出击。
震地龙拔地而起，双肩钻头高速旋转，流影飞狐拔地而起，流影神弓出现在手中。
震地龙正面撞向蝙蝠人机甲，双钻头与音波刃碰撞，火花在树洞中炸开。
content_en:
8. The Heart of the God Tree Huang Xuejing, a little girl who is a brave person in the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese low-level technology, Yang Xinying, a little girl who is a power in the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese low-level technology, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy who is a brave person in the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese low-level technology, and Hu Wei, a little boy named Panda Beast in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, already knew the original history.
That period of history is recorded like this - Xiangtian, Yashu, Miya and Tian Nana knew the whereabouts of the patient mentioned by the guardian of the Tenshen Tree, and borrowed the villagers' ladders to climb up the huge Tenshen Tree.
Meiya awakens the god tree through singing. On the other hand, Morey took the Demon Sword, which was refined from the Demon King's power, in an attempt to kill Tianshenmu completely.
Xiangtian, Yashu, Miya and Tian Nana tried their best to stop it, asking Miya to take the pollen to treat the god tree first.
Morey cunningly shook them off and took the lead to smash the bottle containing sunflower pollen with the Demon Sword.
Because the demon sword was stained with pollen, the god tree was resurrected as a blessing in disguise. In order to thank Xiang Tian, ​​Ya Shu, Miya and Tian Nana, Tian Shen Mu teleported them to the Holy Beast Zone.
That was the original history before time and space were reversed. But it's different now. Huang Xuejing, a little girl from China's low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from China's low-level technology White Yuan Brave World's Power, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World's Wisdom, and Hu Wei, a little boy from the giant panda beast of China's low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, let Meiya, a little girl from the cat human race who is the guide of the Chinese low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World, sing.
Meiya stood on the huge trunk of the Celestial Tree, her hands lightly pressed on the rough bark surface, her lips slightly parted.
Song flowed from her throat, not words, but melody - an ancient awakening song passed down from generation to generation among cat people.
The song spread in all directions along the bark lines of the Celestial Tree, and a low resonance came from deep in the trunk, as if something finally moved its fingers after a long slumber.
Huang Xuejing, a little girl from China's low-level science and technology Baiyuan Brave World, listened to the singing and said softly: "In the final analysis, it is essentially the power of the hope and hope of the earth." Eight people climbed up along the natural passage inside the trunk of the Celestial Tree, and came to the tree hole where the heart of the Celestial Tree is.
It was a huge space. The walls of the cave were densely wrapped with glowing vines, and the vines all converged on a floating yellow bright ball of light in the center of the cave.
The ball of light is large, big enough to accommodate several people standing in it. Yellow light energy lines are flowing on the surface. Every time it beats, the veins of the entire celestial tree will flash simultaneously.
That is the heart of the Celestial Tree. But the luster of the heart was wrong - it should have been yellow, but now it was covered with a dark shadow, and its beating frequency was slow and unstable.
The ethereal bat-man fell from the top of the tree hole and hung upside down on the tree wall. He was driving a thin black mecha, with two pairs of metal bat wings spread out on his back, and two sonic blades at the end of his arms.
Morey stood on a tree wall platform behind the Batman mecha, holding the Demon God's Sword in his hand - the sword was dark purple, refined from the Demon King's power, and black electric light danced on the blade.
Morey's mecha, named Morey's Ethereal Machine, is floating behind him at the moment. It has a slender body, dark purple armor, and the core of its chest beats in sync with the black lightning of the Demon God's Sword.
The little boy Xiangtian raised his right wrist, the summoner was fixed on his wrist, and the badge was inserted into the summoner.
"Gale wind!" The Vitality Vajra rose up from the ground in a gale, and the red armor burned like a ball of flame in the bright yellow light of the tree hole.
The Divine Light Sword appeared in Gale's hands - the red sword in his left hand and the black sword in his right hand. China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Brave Warrior The little boy Xiangtian stood in the pattern space, and the two swords of the gale crossed and slashed towards Morey.
Morey lifts the devilSword of God blocks. The black electric light of the Demon God's Sword collided with the red and black light blade of the Divine Light Sword, and energy fragments flew everywhere.
The Demon God's Sword began to absorb the blade energy of the gale - the black electric light on the dark purple sword became thicker. The more energy it absorbed, the stronger its power to destroy the God Wood.
But this time it was different. The little girl Huang Xuejing from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, the little girl Yang Xinying from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Power, the little boy Tang Qiongkai from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Wisdom, and the little boy Hu Wei from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Giant Panda Beast activate the star card at the same time.
Four magical sky-yellow rays of light shot out from the four star cards, forming a screen of interference light between Morey and Gale Wind.
The light curtain has no offensive power. It only does one thing - blocking the absorption circuit of the Demon God's Sword. The black electric light of the Demon God's Sword was bounced back to the sword the moment it came into contact with the light screen, and the absorption channel was cut off.
Morey's expression changed. Morey was unable to absorb the power of the gale with the Demon Sword. He gritted his teeth and turned to the heart of the Celestial Wood. He personally piloted Morey's ethereal machine to raise the Demon God's Sword and stab the heart's light ball directly.
Without the absorbed energy, the destructive power of the Demon God Sword itself is not enough to destroy the heart with one blow, but it is enough to cause serious damage.
Yashu, a little boy from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors' Vitality Brave World of Power, and Tian Nana, a little girl named Tian Nana's wisdom and courage from China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors' World of Vitality Braves, attack at the same time.
The Earthshaking Dragon rises from the ground, the drill bits on its shoulders rotate at high speed, the Liuying Flying Fox rises from the ground, and the Liuying Divine Bow appears in its hand.
Earthquake Dragon collided head-on with the Bat-Man mecha, the twin drills collided with the sonic blades, and sparks exploded in the tree hole.
